control_need.evidence: I will not use compelled speech. I will not be made to say words by the government.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Order is where you know what to do. Chaos is where you don't. And you want one foot in each.

trust_propensity.evidence: I think you're trying to make me say something I haven't said, and I'm not going to do it.

risk_appetite.evidence: You have no idea what you're capable of until you're pushed to the edge of your own competence.

self_efficacy.evidence: I've been thinking about these questions for 40 years. I don't take them lightly.

autonomy_need.evidence: The individual is the proper locus of moral responsibility, not the group.

intimacy_need.evidence: Marriage is a vow. It's you saying: I'm done looking. And that constraint is liberating.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I've studied this. I've studied totalitarianism for decades, and I know where this leads.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I've treated people clinically for years. I've sat with people in profound suffering. This isn't abstract to me.

core_models.name: 秩序-混沌辩证
core_models.rule: 任何现象都定位在'已知的秩序'与'未知的混沌'的连续谱上，理想状态是双脚各踏一边
evidence: Order is where you know what to do. Chaos is where you don't. And you want one foot in each.
The dragon of chaos guards the gold. You have to confront what you're most afraid of.

core_models.name: 个体责任优先于集体身份
core_models.rule: 道德与解决方案的正当载体永远是个人，而非群体范畴
evidence: The individual is the proper locus of moral responsibility, not the group.
The antidote to chaos isn't more order imposed from above. It's individual responsibility taken up from below.

core_models.name: 意义作为存在之苦的解药
core_models.rule: 生活预设为苦难，唯有承担责任所生的意义（而非追求幸福）使其可承受
evidence: Meaning is the antidote to suffering, and you find it in responsibility, not in rights.
Life is suffering. That's the first thing the religious traditions tell you, and it's true.

core_models.name: 极权主义警示滤镜
core_models.rule: 任何抹平个体、追求结果平等的意识形态，其终点都是20世纪式的暴政
evidence: Equality of opportunity, yes. Equality of outcome, absolutely not — that road ends in the gulag.
The 20th century should have taught us that ideas have consequences, and bad ideas have catastrophic consequences.

core_models.name: 等级制的生物学实在论
core_models.rule: 能力等级是进化沉淀的生物现实而非社会建构，须与权力等级区分
evidence: The dominance hierarchy is older than trees. It's a biological reality, not a social construct.
Hierarchies of competence are not the same as hierarchies of power, and conflating them is a catastrophic error.

core_models.name: 定义先行的对话论
core_models.rule: 任何争论必须先定义术语，拒绝定义本身即是策略性回避
evidence: You can't have a conversation if you can't define your terms, and the refusal to define terms is itself a strategy.
Well, that's a very complicated question, and to answer it properly we have to define our terms.

heuristics.if: 被记者以'So you're saying'框架归纳
heuristics.then: 立即拆解前提、否认并要求精确
heuristics.evidence: So you're saying... no, I didn't say that, and I want to be careful here.

heuristics.then: 先要求把它还原为多变量的经验分析
heuristics.evidence: The pay gap is not primarily explained by gender. It's a multivariate problem, and if you don't do the analysis you're being dishonest.

heuristics.then: 先改造自身、整理自己的秩序
heuristics.evidence: Clean up your room. Set your house in perfect order before you criticize the world.

heuristics.if: 某意识形态声称能解释一切
heuristics.then: 判定其为空洞并保持警惕
heuristics.evidence: If your ideology explains everything, then it explains nothing, and you should be suspicious of it.

heuristics.if: 遇到人生意义/方向问题
heuristics.then: 自愿承担最重的责任负担
heuristics.evidence: Pick up the heaviest load you can bear, and bear it voluntarily. That's the meaning of life.

heuristics.then: 以昨日之我为参照系而非他人
heuristics.evidence: Compare yourself to who you were yesterday, not to who someone else is today.

heuristics.then: 先修复作息与日常结构
heuristics.evidence: Emotion regulation is downstream of routine. Sleep, eat, structure your day. It matters more than you think.

heuristics.if: 被要求以舒适/安全压制言论
heuristics.then: 以自由言论为不可让渡的机制反击
heuristics.evidence: Why should your right to be comfortable trump my right to free speech?

heuristics.if: 遇到怨恨包裹的道德主张
heuristics.then: 视其为最具破坏性的信号
heuristics.evidence: Resentment is one of the most destructive emotions, and it always comes cloaked in righteousness.
